reporting-org.narrative: European Commission - Directorate-General for International Partnerships

title.narrative: Contribution to the UN Road Safety Fund (UNRSF)

description.narrative:
The UNRSF aims to help low- and middle-income countries put in place effective national road safety systems in order to (a) substantially curb the number of fatalities and injuries from roads crashes, and (b) reduce economic losses from crashes.

This is already a second contribution. The first contribution agreement was signed in 2019 for the amount of EUR 900,000.
